facts.1. First contracted caravan is scheduled: 30; the caravan arrived on schedule. By 07:45 the first inspection findings reported that submitted papers, presented identities, declared cargo class, and visible load were mutually consistent. No hold was requested; routine inspection and custody work continue through 09:50 without a reported exception.
facts.2. Sword Manor Commander Wei Jian reques: 00 command council; it convened at 08:00 under Wei Jian's standing authority. Its provisional recommendation remains to honor existing escort obligations and avoid fresh trainee reallocation until a House principal gives further direction. Wei Jian later visited the family hall for a short command consultation and returned to Sword Manor without changing that posture.
facts.adjacent_security: Duan Jin and Shen Rui remain on protective duty near the family-hall approaches; no immediate alarm is active and they have not yet been formally briefed on the Qin service plan
available_reports_already_delivered: Kanyou intelligence case opened with Tang Ling; inner contents known to Tang Wei and Tang Ling
Main Gate first inspection findings delivered to Tang Wei
Sword Manor opening council note and provisional recommendations delivered to Tang Wei

Wei Jian command counsel delivered directly: a 50-100-man Qin officer-test target is a reasonable proving scale, but Qin must grant the appointment and separately accept any private-retinue attachment; Tang Wei's 52 retainers are not yet a formed troop unit
facts.current_decision: At 09:50 Tang Wei has clarified that he wants Qin to test him for an officer command around 50-100 men, intends to bring his 52 personal retainers if Qin permits, has limited Tang Kai to protected camp and field exposure rather than actual battle contact, has received Wei Jian's counsel, and has directed Tang Ling to investigate the real Qin entry and assignment path. The inquiry is out and unanswered.
facts.forbidden_inference: These plans and inquiries do not themselves create Qin enlistment, officer appointment, Duke Hyou assignment, Qin acceptance of the personal retinue, permanent troop units for the 52 retainers, movement of the retinue, or movement of Tang Kai.
facts.immediate_pressure: Kanyou remains politically uncertain; the caravan continues through routine inspection; Sword Manor retains its existing posture; Tang Ling's Qin military-service inquiry is now in motion; Tang Wei's 52 personal retainers remain unorganized pending any later unit decision.
facts.participants: Tang Wei, Tang Zhu, Tang Ling, and Tang Kai remain in the family hall; Wei Jian visited during the interval and returned to loc_sword_manor_command_hall

records.label: scene_tang_wei_sixteenth_birthday_dawn_001
notes: The inner Kanyou report remains restricted to Tang Wei and Tang Ling.
Tang Wei has clarified his intended Qin entry target: request an officer test and seek roughly a 50-100-man command rather than merely entering as an ordinary ranker if Qin accepts him.
Tang Wei intends to bring his personal retinue if Qin permits; the canonical retinue contains 52 unorganized members and no permanent troop units.
Tang Wei has chosen a current safety boundary for Tang Kai: protected camp, march, supply-route, and controlled field observation are acceptable; actual battle contact is not while Kai is this young.
Wei Jian gave a professional pre-assessment but no Qin authority: the requested command scale is a reasonable proving target, while appointment and retinue attachment remain Qin decisions.
Tang Ling organized and dispatched discreet Qin military-service inquiries between 09:25 and 09:50; no reply has returned yet.
No current House Tang information confirms a placement path under Duke Hyou.
